name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (architect → explore → design) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → optional /spec:design (mock-bound, deterministic fidelity gates) → /spec:build (direct Sonnet worker dispatch per layer wave, executed red-check) → /spec:review (spec-review-driver.js stepped, the design-driver pattern: deterministic legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros; verdict derived by verdict.js) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.25.0 — the two unattended-replay blockers hit on 2026-08-23's driver-scheduled run (rv_387d84a3b424) are closed. (1) `replay.js --setup` accepts a `--dir` that resolves inside `<root>/.claude/worktrees/` — narrowly, not any gitignored in-repo path — so the scratch worktree lands where the permission classifier already auto-approves agent Edit/Write (build worktrees prove this daily), instead of forcing `/private/tmp`, where the classifier denied every mutation-authoring edit on both live runs that day. Before `git worktree add`, `--setup` runs `git check-ignore -q` on the target and self-provisions `.claude/worktrees/` into `<common git dir>/info/exclude` when the host's own ignore rules don't already cover it (skipped when the line is already present), so `git status` in the main root stays empty regardless of the host's `.gitignore`. Every other in-repo `--dir` keeps the exit-3 refusal verbatim; an outside-repo `--dir` (the old `mktemp -d` default) remains an accepted manual fallback. (2) `--select` no longer emits a spec's symbolic `build_base` (typically `main`) as the diff base — stale the moment the review's own merge lands, which had been producing phantom out-of-plan and unrealized files in reconcile (observed: exit 3, two of each, until hand-pinned). It now reads frontmatter at the close commit, tries `diff_base` then `build_base`, and emits the first candidate that resolves to a full sha ancestor of `parent` distinct from `parent`; no candidate qualifying is now exit 4 (widened population, same alphabet), naming the stale-base cause and the stamped-at-close remedy. `spec-review-driver.js` stamps `diff_base: <sha>` into frontmatter at the `implementing → done` flip whenever the field is absent, resolving the base ref at flip time — the last moment a symbolic ref and the true pre-image coincide — and never overwrites an existing value. `spec/commands/replay.md`'s Phase 1 setup step and main-tree-scope rule are reworded to match: isolation now comes from the detached worktree, the self-provisioned ignore line, and the private-git-dir marker guard together, not from living outside the repo. 7.24.0 — the three review-close defects surfaced at the 2026-08-23 close of specs/20260823/01 (rv_6825fa48c98d) are closed. (1) `spec/scripts/lib/frontmatter.js` becomes the sole frontmatter derivation across all four JS readers, exporting `fmBlock`/`fmValue`/`fmMap`: `fmValue` supersedes 7.23.0's `fmVal` by rename — no alias survives, since a second name for one derivation is the drift this ends. The two drivers 7.23.0 already routed through it pick up the renamed export; `spec-status.js` and `replay.js` join them, retiring private kv loops whose `.replace(/\s*#.*$/, '')` stripped at ANY `#` and so corrupted an unspaced value such as a `design_source:` URL fragment — `spec-status.js` was NOT, as 7.23.0's note claimed, already correct. Quoted values unwrap verbatim; unquoted values cut at the first whitespace-preceded `#`. (2) The review driver's merge step becomes re-entrant, closing the recorded deadlock at rv_6825fa48c98d: evidence promotion had deleted the worktree's tracked ledger copy, `git worktree remove` refused, the driver died mid-`finishMerge`, and the retry re-ran `merge-back.sh merge` and died on `assert_clean_root` against its own promoted evidence — a permanent wedge at MERGE with no recorded mark. `handleMergeStrategy` now detects an already-landed merge (`git rev-list --count target..source` = 0, or a deleted branch) and resumes at promotion/cleanup instead of re-merging; `promoteEvidenceAndClean` restores tracked worktree copies to HEAD instead of deleting them, so cleanup runs without `--force`. `merge-back.sh` itself is deliberately untouched — its exit-code alphabet (3 = conflicts, 4 = CWD refusal) and `assert_clean_root` stay load-bearing; only when and how the driver invokes it changed. (3) `.claude/agent-memory/**` joins `BASELINE_GLOBS` in `lib/glob-match.js`, so worker memories stop raising an out-of-plan finding on every worker-dispatching build — no File Plan can enumerate the memories a worker will write, and review CLOSE's per-file content disposal is strictly stronger than a path flag. Known consequence: collision-closure's repo walk now also prunes memory files. 7.23.0 — the 2026-08-21..23 upwell silent-drop incident closed in three parts. (1) `lib/spec-sections.js`'s bare-only trailing-tag rule (rv_640c582f4902) refused a BACKTICKED trailing tag silently, so a host writing genuine `[oracle:]`/`[env:]`/`[pre-green:]` declarations backticked at the trailing position saw them misreported as plain `uncovered-ac`/`unsanctioned-skip`/`unsanctioned-green` with no trace of the cause (upwell: 17 dropped declarations). `parseAcBullets` now also returns `trailingRejected` — the backtick-tolerant trailing run's text when the bare-only run refused it, built from the SAME `TAG_ITEM_SRC` the declaration slot uses, never a second regex authority — and `ac-matrix.js` and `red-check.js` emit the new hard finding `rejected-trailing-tag` in its place, naming the AC-ID, the refused tag, and both readings' remedies. Loud-when-it-bites, never unconditional: the new class REPLACES the generic finding (never both for one AC) only when the refusal is causally relevant, so the illustration bullets the bare-only ban exists to ignore stay silent, and nothing about what PARSES changes. The two manifest leg exits partition by emission site rather than by finding class — a class both loops emit would otherwise redden a leg that observed nothing, a silent misreport into the evidence manifest `verdict.js` reads. (2) New `spec/scripts/lib/frontmatter.js` is the one shared frontmatter-value reader: `spec-review-driver.js` and `spec-design-driver.js` each carried an identical local `fmVal` whose regex captured everything after `key:` including an inline `#` comment — cosmetic on `tier:` until seven live review ledger rows carried a whole sentence inside it, and outright fatal on `build_base:` (rv_e83659d49386). Quoted values return content to the matching close quote; unquoted values strip a whitespace-preceded `#`, so an unspaced `#` inside a URL fragment survives. `spec-status.js` is deliberately untouched — its reader was already correct and it is a frozen critical-tier API. (3) The seven polluted ledger `tier` fields are repaired in place and specs/20260821/03 D8's slipped post-land archaeology is executed as escape rows.
